findings.summary: Reused table_region_unverifiable, which already denotes the D3 fail-closed disposition; consumers cannot tell detection from disposition and a D3 page carries the kind twice.
findings.how: New kind table_region_geometry_hard_fail. Added explicitly to TABLE_DISTRUST_KINDS (tables_trust.py) with a comment stating the detection/disposition split, and to the rank dict in audit_log.py at rank 4, immediately before table_region_unverifiable at 5, so a D3 page's audit log reads detected-then-acted-on in order. native_fallback 5->6, page_failed 6->7; no test pinned those. New test test_d3_page_carries_detection_and_disposition_once_each drives a real D3 page through process() and asserts each kind appears exactly once and in that order.

findings.how: Renamed to test_surfacing_does_not_key_page_status_or_routing_scope_guard and widened to the whole of process(), parametrized over four cells (agentic x flagged). Pins page status, audit_passed, failure mode, document status and the OCR call list to values MEASURED at base 7696719. Patches _available_engines_for_agentic to [PROFILE_QWEN_LOCAL] for CI hermeticity. Pinning rather than flagged-vs-clean equality because the TR-3 flag already influences some of those outcomes through pre-existing paths (D3 floor, native_fallback) that #205 does not touch — an equality test would assert something untrue. This is stated explicitly in the test comment and the PR body.
